correctness.rationale: On the five covering standard opens, direct exact elimination gives D(d): af-b²=0, D(e): af-c⁴=0, D(g): af-d⁴e²=0, and on D(a),D(f) the rank-one 2×3 scroll-minor cones. Singular gradients give precisely L_dg ∪ L_eg ∪ {p_a,p_f}; the transverse A1/A3 types and meeting germ follow. For scroll S(1,2) on F1, K+2H=F with [F] of infinite order modulo H, so isolated cones are non-Q-Gorenstein; other opens are hypersurfaces. The projective cone joins the singular set with its P4 vertex. Independently reproduced all chart eliminations algebraically; these establish global set equality, not only finite coordinate supports.
